title: Semicon Series 2 | Nvidia’s $3.5 Billion Bet: Why MediaTek Built a New Team With Intel and Apple Veterans
text:

MediaTek is no longer just a smartphone chip company.

As it pushes deeper into AI ASICs, the Taiwanese chipmaker is quietly rebuilding the organization behind its chips—bringing in veterans from Intel, Apple and TSMC, creating a new advanced packaging unit, and rethinking how it manages suppliers and secures critical components.

Then came Nvidia’s $3.5 billion bet.

Why does MediaTek need that much financial firepower? And why have manufacturing, supply chain and advanced packaging suddenly moved from supporting roles to center stage?

Semicon Series 2 goes inside MediaTek’s transformation—and what it reveals about the new rules of the AI chip race.
